title: Edge CAPEX & Ops algorithmic pricing sandbox
content:
Purpose:
This is a working sandbox (spreadsheet-style) for exploring hybrid CAPEX/OpEx pricing heuristics and bundle recommendations for private deployments (on-prem and VPC). The goal is to produce compact, actionable rules-of-thumb that an AE or solutions engineer can use to: (1) estimate first-order TCO for a customer, (2) recommend a licensing + support bundle mix, and (3) identify early upsell levers (dedicated vs burst, premium SLAs, managed-initial-deploy).

High-level approach / assumptions (living):
- Time horizon: 36 months by default; sensitivity runs at 24 and 60 months.
- Hardware amortization: default 36mo straight-line for purchased hardware; 36mo blended for leased GPUs with 8% effective lease carry.
- Utilization definition: average of peak batchable utilization (weighted tokens per second) with headroom planning +20% for safety.
- Software license: base perpetual or term license depending on customer preference; default pricing model = term annual license with % of monthly OpEx floor.
- Support tiers: Bronze (email, 48h), Silver (business hours, 24h), Gold (24/7, 4h), Platinum (SLA-backed, 1h + on-call).
- Quantization/acceleration discounts: assume token cost reduction 18%-40% depending on aggressiveness of quantization and model family (applied as negative OpEx).

Key levers included in the model (to iterate):
- HW: GPUs count, GPU type, PUE, density (nodes per rack), spare capacity reserve.
- Licensing: flat seat fee vs usage multiplier vs blended term license.
- Support: included hours, response SLA, remote-hands level.
- Managed services add-ons: initial deployment, patching, monitoring exports, 3rd-party KMS integration.
- Routing/fallback policy: ability to route to hosted tier reduces peak capacity requirement by X% at cost Y per token.

Quick heuristics produced so far (draft):
1) Small customers (<10 peak GPUs) - recommend VPC term license + Bronze support + optional managed on-boarding. Rationale: low capex sensitivity, faster time-to-value.
2) Mid customers (10-50 peak GPUs) - recommend hybrid bundle: 36mo partial-capex (customer buys 60% of baseline GPUs or leases) + Silver support. Add optional burst credit to hosted layer to cap capex and handle seasonal peaks.
3) Large customers (>50 peak GPUs) - recommend Dedicated private licensing (term + annual reserved commitment), Gold support, and offer hardware financing to smooth CAPEX. Include incentive: reserved throughput discount (8%-15%) vs pure on-demand.

Representative sensitivity outputs (see sheet rows):
- Break-even month (compared to fully-hosted at current list unit price) calculated with 36-month horizon and discount rate 7%
- Unit token cost (USD per 1e6 tokens) after amortization and support allocation
- Monthly effective spend by category: amortized capex, hw maintenance, electricity, license amort, support, managed services, hosted fallback credits

Open questions / modeling gaps to resolve:
- How to model colocation/space/network egress variability across regions (EMEA/APAC). Currently we use a single geography multiplier table; need finer granularity.
- Fleet heterogeneity: mixing A100 and H100 variants - how to fold into utilization and packing efficiency.
- Exchange rates and tax treatment for multi-year leases.
- Precise defintion of "peak GPUs" for burstable workloads - should we model percentiles (p50/p95/p99) instead of an absolute peak?

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Miguel: wire-up variant table for GPU unit prices and lease vs buy math (JIRA-5568).
- Priya: interview 3 recent mid-market customers to validate recommended Silver bundle and managed onboarding willingness (target by 2026-03-01).
- Jordan: prototype UI compact estimator (copy-ready) for AE quoting tool - MVP supporting 3 scenario presets and CSV export.

Notes to reviewer:
- This is intentionally messy - the purpose is to capture heuristics and counterexamples not yet formalized in the canonical pricing model. Please highlight any false assumptions and paste example customer profiles that contradict these heuristics.

Metrics we want surfaced in console for bundle decisions (for product/AE alignment):
- Effective USD per 1e6 tokens (amortized) per route (private / hosted)
- Breakeven months vs hosted baseline
- Monthly committed spend vs incremental managed fees (to flag value of managed services)
- Fraction of capacity hedged by hosted fallback (reduces capex need)

Reference formulas (exposed in sheet rows as plain text):
- amortized_capex_monthly = purchase_cost / amortization_months + maintenance_pct * purchase_cost / 12
- effective_token_cost = (monthly_amortized_capex + monthly_hw_ops + license_monthly + support_monthly + managed_monthly - hosted_credit) / estimated_monthly_tokens * 1e6
- break_even_months = cumulative_cost_private_vs_hosted crosses zero (discounting applied at 7% annual)

TODO / tidy before marking final:
- Convert this sheet into canonical product pricing inputs (Confluence page) with tidy presets for Small/Mid/Large.
- Add EMEA/APAC region multipliers per market.
- Validate quantization discount bands with Applied ML team (SRE and Runtime).

End of sandbox description.
